extraction: Claude Code Hooks Guide: Hooks run at lifecycle points for deterministic control. Use cases: format files after edits, block commands before execution, send notifications when Claude needs input, inject context at session start. Hook types: command (shell), http (POST to endpoint), prompt (LLM evaluation), agent (subagent verification), mcp_tool (call MCP tool). Settings in ~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json. Notification hook example: osascript for macOS desktop notification. PostToolUse hook: format files after Edit/Write with prettier. SessionStart hook: direnv export for environment. Hooks in skills and agents: defined in skill/subagent file. Block edits to protected files (.env, package-lock.json, .git/) via PreToolUse hook with script.
